Quick triage notes from telemetry (08:30 snapshot):
- KV eviction rate for CloudFolio tenant spiked x18 in the 07:48-07:56 window.
- Prefetch queue length climbed and failed to drain for ~7 minutes. That pattern aligns with head-of-line blocking (single hot prefix causing prefetches to queue and stall other keys).
- Hot-shard metrics show sustained tail-latency on the prefetch workers; batching across multiple tenants aggravated the stall.

Immediate mitigations I pushed at 08:40 (applied to prod, reversible):
1) Enabled tenant-isolation profile for CF (allocates reserved prefetch slots, prevents cross-tenant slot stealing).
2) Temporarily bumped reserved slots from 2 -> 6 for the tenant (reduces HOL impact).
3) Lowered prefetch aggressiveness (prefetch window) for high-variance prefixes.
4) Applied emergency eviction-policy change to prefer MRU for prefetch-promoted keys (reduces churn).

Preliminary result (08:44): error rate falling to ~1.2%, p99 down to ~850ms, throughput recovering. Still watching.

Attachments: prefetch_lockup_playbook_v1.md (playbook with rollback notes), tenant_isolation_config.patch

I'll follow with persisted metrics and a proposed permanent config.

— Ben Carter
